title: garland not realistic at all
text: garland not realistic at all. Was disappointed in quality of this item.  The flowers are not at all realistic.  It was so lightweight, and the lilies were flat.  Real Lilies of the Valley stand up and out, with lots of larger leaves surrounding them.  These delicate flowers did not lend themselves to a garland.

product_metadata.title: 6' White Lily of the Valley Garland
description: Beautiful lily of the valley garland in white. These white lilies of the valley with leafy green accents make this floral garland perfect for decorating reception tables and wedding decor for a romantic touch.- 6' Long- White
